errors.text_span: in einem regelmäßigen Intervall von einem Jahr
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are shown at an interval of two years, not one year.
The y-axis has a linear scale, not a logarithmic one, as the intervals between 0-50, 50-100, 100-150, etc., are equally spaced.
The chart legend and visual representation clearly show eight distinct lines, not four.

errors.text_span: Die dunkelgraue Linie, unterbrochene Punkte, stellt die Staatsschuldenquote Griechenlands dar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, Greece (Griechenland) is represented by a light blue solid line, not a dark gray line with interrupted points (which represents Belgium).

errors.text_span: einen Rückgang von etwa 75 % um 2008 und einen Anstieg von etwa 60 % um 2015
errors.evidence: This phrasing is nonsensical. The chart shows values *at* certain percentages, not decreases or increases *of* those percentages. For example, it should state 'a value of approximately 75%', not 'a decrease of approximately 75%'.

errors.text_span: Die hellgraue Linie, eine gestrichelte Linie, stellt die Staatsschuldenquote Irlands dar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, Ireland (Irland) is represented by a green solid line, not a light gray dashed line.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie, eine durchgezogene Linie, stellt die Staatsschuldenquote Belgien dar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, Belgium (Belgien) is represented by a black dotted line, not a blue solid line.
There is no orange line in the chart.
The description incorrectly maps an imaginary orange line to Spain, which is actually represented by a purple solid line.
There is no brown line in the chart.
The description incorrectly maps an imaginary brown line to France, which is actually represented by a very light blue solid line.
The description fails to mention all eight lines present in the chart as requested by the prompt ('Eine Beschreibung jeder Linie...'). It completely omits the lines for 'Eurozone' and 'Italien'.
